issue.title: Agents-pane PNG goldens stale after the r/R swap and V metadata footer hints: ~120 visual tests fail on master
issue.description: FOUND BY the sase-z4.6.5.4.6 land agent (2026-09-14) while rechecking the weighted-capacity strip corpus for parent sase-z4.6.5.4. The capacity strip is unchanged and still matches its goldens; this drift is NOT weighted-capacity. Diffing expected/actual/diff PNGs (for example agents_weighted_runner_capacity_120x40, bbox spans y=0..1026 at ~0.3% changed pixels) shows two causes. (1) The bottom keymap footer changed: goldens still show 'r retry', 'n name / x kill' and no V hint, while renders show 'R retry', 'V metadata', 'W new w/ wait' and 'x kill' relaid out. That comes from src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_keybinding_bindings.py commits 5be4f6ae32 'feat(ace): swap Agents r/R so r refreshes and R retries' (tale swap_agents_retry_refresh) and a59ded7669 'feat(ace,pager): open agent metadata in the pager with V' (tale agents_metadata_pager); ecfde919c5 (sase-100.4) refreshed only some goldens. (2) Some rows now render an extra ' ×2' model-alias pool weight chip (src/sase/ace/tui/model_alias_styles.py) after the status, which shifts the rest of the row; confirm whether that is intended fixture/config drift before rebaselining. Remediation: regenerate the agents-pane corpus deliberately with --sase-update-visual-snapshots, inspecting that each diff is explained by the footer hints or the chip. Name any golden whose diff has another cause instead of sweeping it in. Related but distinct: sase-x5 (per-golden renderer drift backlog).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic and matches CI: scheduled Full CI run 34808346506 (2863ed2f19) visual-test reports 120 failed / 827 passed, 119 of them agents-pane nodes. A local just test-visual of tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents*.py at 8bd8fb891d gives 114 failed / 9 passed, and Full CI has failed on every scheduled run since 2026-09-12.
